title: Excellent
text: This is a must do. Apart from the amazing Cordoba itself which is a ‘must do’ trip. The service given could not be faulted. Both the driver and the tour guide could not have been better. Absolutely recommend.
author: Alison_J

title: Majestic and breathtaking
text: Our guide Carmen was very good in accommodating our interest and adjust the schedule accordingly! We got to see stuff that was not on the itinerary! The mosque and cathedral have beautiful architecture. Lots of people though so difficult to take photos!
author: kdcarroll2003

title: Sights Not To Be Missed
text:
Our tour guide, Olivia, was very knowledgeable and explained all aspects of The Jewish Quarter and Mosque/Cathedral in understandable terms.  She was patient with our questions and the time we took taking many photos.  She also took photos of us in several places when appropriate, always asking our permission. 
These beautiful sights of Cordoba should be seen and experienced by everyone.  This was my second time coming to Cordoba but I learned so much more from Olivia.  
I have trouble walking nowadays and Olivia was patient about that also—very often offering her hand to help me. 
Our driver
author: adrian_b

title: cordoba amazing day
text:
Incredible day visiting Cordoba. The image of the roman bridge, scene of game of thrones, was one of the highlights of my trip. Our guide was attentive, patient and kind. Her English was excellent.
The driver was very courteous and professional.
author: Chousicklass

title: Incredible trip to Cordoba!
text:
We had several days in Seville and decided to make a daytrip to Cordoba. The vehicle that picked us up at our hotel was excellent, and the driver was very friendly.

In Cordoba, there are not enough words to talk about Inma, our guide. She showed us the mosque and the Jewish quarter with passion and love.

thank you for everything!
author: conorg762

title: mosque of cordoba
text:
Cordoba is one of the cities with the highest number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites, a first surprise.
The "mosque" is not a mosque, but a cathedral, second surprise.
And the third surprise was our guide, Elena, a fantastic girl. We couldn't have been happier.
author: JenCarPer

title: Cordoba trip
text:
I had not heard much about Cordoba, but our guide in Seville recommended us to go to this city. 
The communication with the agency was fantastic from minute 1. In Cordoba we were lucky to have Angela as our guide, a local girl full of energy and humour.
After the tour, we had free time for lunch and our driver took us back to the hotel.
author: eduardodF542RM

title: Cordoba is wonderful
text:
Don't miss Cordoba if you go to Seville! It's only 2 hours from Seville and it's definitely worth it. The mosque is one of the most impressive buildings we have ever seen. Our guide was Elena, enthusiastic and passionate.
Great experience, highly recommended.
author: nuria_caro
